title: Otori Emu — Clear-Eyed To The Future〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Revue - Office

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: ...which makes this a crucial point.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We thought she might be feeling lonely studying management all by herself...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But Emu's really working hard.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, she's listening so closely...!>

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: Next, I'd like to discuss how the revue makes contributions to society.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I'm listening!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Still, it really is just Emu.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is the person talking someone from the revue?>

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: One of the ways we follow through on our mission statement is by helping our surrounding communities.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Surrounding communities...?
Do you mean the ones in this city? The one where the Morinomiya Revue is located?

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: Yes. We have been able to exist for this long because of the support of the locals, and we're always doing our best to return the favor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Phoenix Wonderland also works with the communities surrounding it from time to time...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (But I wonder what Morinomiya does...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I have a question!
How does Morinomiya engage with the locals?

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
Excellent question.
We participate in local events, and even put on performances at elementary and junior high schools.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Local events...?

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: Hehe. I was only going to give a quick explanation here, but I feel that I should provide you with more details now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: You were listening so closely to what I had to say just now. I'll bring over some documents detailing what we do a little later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Emu seems so cool right now...!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'm really impressed! She's taking lots of notes and asking all these great questions...>

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: That's everything as far as our contributions to society go. Do you have any further questions?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No further questions.
Thank you very much for being so thorough with me!

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: My plan is to next have you actually help out backstage, but let's take a break first. Please meet me outside of the theatre in thirty minutes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! I'll be looking forward to our next activity!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, during my break, I gotta review everything I just learned.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see...
<Hey, Emu.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hi, Len, Rin!
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We came over to see how your studies are going.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Management sounds really hard, but you seem to be having a lot of fun.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, things have been really fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys know how the people in management work really hard behind the scenes to make the company's most precious goals a reality, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've been learning so many new things that I want to figure out how to think like they do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Even when we were talking just now about making contributions to society, I learned that what they do is way different from what Phoenix Wonderland does.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hehe. We saw you asking all those questions.>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Some of the things they do seemed really fun, so I wanna see if we can give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Both our companies do stuff with the locals, but we mostly just do simple public engagement events...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: While Morinomiya places a lot of value on going around and doing full-on shows for people.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Putting on shows in a bunch of different places like we did with those ambassadorial performances would be a great way to get lots of different people to talk about the park...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, maybe that won't work. The troupes have to practice and do shows almost every day already...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, I wanna come up with a fun idea that'll make the locals and everybody at the park smile.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, we were a little worried about you having to study all by yourself...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But I guess our worries were misplaced, since you're obviously having a lot of fun!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm totally fine!
I really am having fun learning about all these different things!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, we could tell just by watching!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, can you tell us more about what you've been learning?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure! Let's see... The other day, I learned about...
